title: 963. Distribute Coins in Binary Tree

examples.explanation: The root holds 3 coins but needs 1; moving one coin to each child costs 2 moves.
Three single-step coin moves balance the three nodes.
One coin travels from the right child to the middle child in two steps via the root.
